output.content:
The comparison is saved. Viable cell density, CHO-010-R02 minus CHO-010-R01, at 23 exactly matched elapsed sample times (0.0–328.5 h, unit cells/mL):

- **Mean signed difference: −167,811 cells/mL** (R02 lower on average; median −100,000 cells/mL).
- **Largest absolute difference: 1,466,667 cells/mL**, negative, at **233.5 h elapsed** — R01 at 14,866,667 cells/mL vs R02 at 13,400,000 cells/mL. R02 was higher at 7 of 23 time points (mainly 193.5–217.5 h, peaking at +733,333 cells/mL at 217.5 h).

Both runs peaked around 16 million cells/mL (R01 16,066,667 at 169.0 h; R02 16,166,667 at 209.0 h), and the trajectories cross twice around 117–140 h and 217–233 h. This is descriptive only — successive samples of one run are not independent, so no significance test applies.

**Provisional status:** the values come from the Harborview CDMO · fed-batch delivery, which is still in review — all 46 values used were read from the delivery files and not yet reviewed, so nothing here is verified. Also still in review (not used for this comparison): Harborview CHO-010-R02 through CHO-012-R02 companions, Northfield Biologics · November runs (CHO-007-R01/R02, CHO-008-R01/R02, CHO-009-R01/R02) and Northfield Biologics · October runs (CHO-004-R01/R02, CHO-005-R01/R02, CHO-006-R01/R02), all provisional.

The saved result holds every measured pair with its source; batch context (product, process version, equipment, scale, stage) is not recorded in the delivery, so comparability beyond the shared CMO dataset is not established. Reviewing the Harborview delivery would settle whether these values hold.
